{{TierBar}}

'''Inborn Parasites''' are a tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]] that sits at the bottom of the parasite hierarchy. They are primarily responsible for propagating the infection. In a way, Inborn Parasites can be subdivided into the '''Rupter family''', which initiates the infection and subsequently advances it, and '''Carriers''', which directly promote its spread later on.

Killing all of them at least once grants the player the {{AdvancementLink|Inborn}}.

== ''Spawning''==
===''Buglins''===
*Spawn naturally, from [[Evolution Phases|Phase]] [[Evolution Phases#Phase 0|0]] to [[Evolution Phases|Phase]] [[Evolution Phases#Phase 2|2]], with a spawnweight of 30, in groups of 2 to 6.
* Spawned from certain Assimilated Mobs exploding upon death.
*Spawned by [[Tunnel]] blocks.
*Spawned by [[Flying Carrier|Flying Carriers]].
*Spawned by [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I]], [[Stage II Beckon|II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|III Beckons]]
*Spawned by [[Monarch|Monarchs]].
===''Rupters''===
*Evolve from [[Buglin|Buglins]] after 75 seconds.
*Spawn naturally, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 1|Phase 1]] to [[Evolution Phases#Phase 5|Phase 5]], with a spawnweight of 30, in groups of 3 to 6.
*Spawned by all three Carriers.
*Spawned by [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I]], [[Stage II Beckon|II]], and [[Stage III Beckon|III Beckons]].
*Spawned by [[Summoner (Disambiguation)|Summoners]].
*Spawned by Level 0-3 [[Scent System|Scents]].
*Spawned by [[Overseer|Overseers]].
*Evolve from Buglins stored by [[Stage II Dispatcher|Stage II+ Dispatchers]].
*Spawned by [[Dreadnaut|Ancient Dreadnauts]].
===''Manglers'' ===
*Spawn after a [[Rupter]] accumulates a killcount of 30 and evolves.
*Spawn naturally from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 6|Phase 6]] onwards, with a spawnweight of 30, in groups of 3 to 6.
* Evolves from a Rupter after being stored by a Stage III+ Dispatcher.
*Spawned by [[Herd|Herds]].
===''Flying Carriers''===
*Spawned by Stage II and Stage III Beckons.
===''Heavy Carriers''===
*Spawned by Stage III Beckons.

==''Features''==
Inborn Parasites are very diversified and share very little aspects with each other.

===''Weaknesses''===
Like all Parasites, Inborn Parasites present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled). This is more emphasized in Carriers - if they die while being on fire, they won't be able to release carried Parasites.

==''[[Lore]]''==
*Buglins derive directly from [[The Source]] and make their way to the surface through [[Tunnel|Tunnels]].

==''Trivia''==

* Almost all Inborn Parasites are incapable of [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]], Manglers being the only exception.
